results.fact: Total gain
results.evidence: gain_ft 6,000 equals only the approach to camp; the summit day from a ~6,000-6,200 ft camp over the Ottohorn-Himmelhorn col to 8,151 ft adds more. No outside source states a car-to-car gain for this route, and computing one is not allowed; no patch.

results.fact: Whether the camp zone permit can be reserved in advance
results.correct_value: Walk-up only (not reservable), issued in person at the Marblemount WIC; $10 per person plus a $6 fee, including walk-ups.
results.evidence: The park's cross-country zone page and its reservations page both say only Boston Basin, Eldorado, Sulphide, Price, Triumph and Tapto Lakes can be reserved in advance and every other zone, including Terror Basin and Crescent Creek (6 per party, 6 parties a night), is walk-up only. The park's permit pages give the cost as $10 per person plus a $6 fee, youth 15 and under free, and say the $6 fee also applies to walk-up permits. A 2020 party picked its permit up in person at the Marblemount ranger station. Access text claiming a free permit, free walk-ups, Recreation.gov booking or self-issue is corrected; bivy[] is left to the camping clean-up.
